runs.name: qwen3-4b-cross-method-development
runs.finding: At a matched mid-stack residual layer and development scale, both methods place all thirteen controlled concepts in the neither quadrant. The autoencoder reconstructs the residual with error 0.006 yet retains almost none of each concept next-token logit, a gist-code signature. The single-direction J-lens readout without the final norm is a weak predictor at this scale. Reconstruction quality does not imply concept faithfulness.
runs.caveat: The J-lens fidelity uses one stored direction with no final normalization while the autoencoder retention uses a multivariate probe, so the two axes differ in absolute scale. The agreement statistics are computed over thirteen concepts with thirty-two held-out rows and are development-scale only.
